map.会。工具按 WCAG 相对亮度公式计算相邻色标的对比度，并标注「正文级（≥4.5: Yes. It computes adjacent-stop contrast using the WCAG relative-luminance formula and labels it body-text level (≥4.5:1), large-text/graphic level (≥3:1) or decorative only (<3:1). Note this is contrast between color stops, not between text and its background; body-text color pairing still needs separate checking.
map.色标按位置升序排列后拼为「色值 位置%」序列：线性 → linear-gradi: Stops are sorted by position and joined into a "colour position%" sequence: linear → linear-gradient(angledeg, …); radial → radial-gradient(circle, …); conic → conic-gradient(from angledeg, …); the angle control appears only for linear/conic; random gradients generate 2–4 stops with position = ⌊i ÷ (stops − 1) × 100⌋ and a random integer angle from 0–359. Adjacent-stop contrast uses WCAG relative luminance: L = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B (channels linearised), contrast = (Llight + 0.05) ÷ (Ldark + 0.05); this value only describes how distinct adjacent stops are (≥4.5 clear, ≥3 distinguishable, <3 weak) and is not a WCAG text-level rating.
